description: This file defines a React component for a 'Forgot Password' modal dialog, allowing users to request a password reset link by entering their email address. It manages input validation, renders different button styles for mobile and desktop, and interacts with external modal and form components.

classes.name: ForgotPasswordModal
classes.description: A React component class for the 'Forgot Password' modal dialog, handling email input and user interactions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component and binds the email change handler.

methods.name: onEmailChanged
methods.description: Updates the component state with the entered email and validation status.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal dialog with input fields and buttons, adapting layout for mobile and desktop views.
